definitions.portfolio: Dated equity investments; undated companies are retrieved separately. Debt and grants are excluded.
definitions.amounts: USD whole-round amounts, not the investor's cheque, fund size, assets under management or investment returns.
definitions.follow_on: Another investor's later financing and this investor's repeat backing are distinct. Only entries with a full 24-month observation window enter the cohort.
definitions.sectors: Historical company tags can overlap; their counts are not additive and do not establish a current investment mandate.
definitions.directory: A directory's stored shortlist is a selected subset of its measured investor universe, not every investor in the database.

value.label: Start with the first entry
value.text: Anupam Mittal has dated investments in 268 companies. 252 first entries were at Angel, Pre-Seed or Seed (94.0%). An early-stage founder can use the sector and stage filters to find comparable companies before approaching the investor.

value.label: Separate activity from reputation
value.text: 53 first company relationships appear in the latest 24 months, compared with 50 in the preceding window. The latest recorded investment is 2026-03-28. This describes observed activity through 2026-05-22; it does not establish current availability.

value.label: Plan the next financing step
value.text: 125 of 215 companies with a full 24-month observation window raised another equity round. This investor backed 25 of those companies again within that window. The difference is a reason to research the wider syndicate, rather than assume the same investor will fund the next round.

value.label: Use a specific point of relevance
value.text: B2C E-Commerce is the largest displayed sector by company count, appearing in 85 portfolio companies; sector tags overlap. 81 first entries carry a recorded lead flag and the median first-round syndicate includes 5 other named backers. Shared rounds are evidence of co-investment, not evidence of an introduction route.

notes: Investor metrics use the dated, verified Atlas snapshot. Retrieval time is not data freshness. Use available_fields for separate detail requests.

provenance: Authenticated local gateway; live Radar publication check and verified database-derived Atlas release
hash_basis: Parsed JSON with sorted keys, after any credential redaction
